exposure: misoprostol combined with artificial membrane stripping induction
cohort: Nulliparous women with gestational diabetes mellitus delivering at two specific hospitals in China between 2018 and 2023.
finding: The combination of misoprostol vaginal insert and artificial membrane stripping showed the highest induction of labor success rates, shortest time to labor onset, shortest vaginal delivery time, and lowest chorioamnionitis rates compared to misoprostol alone or double-balloon induction in women with gestational diabetes mellitus.
mod_finding: The combined misoprostol and artificial membrane stripping group effectively improved vaginal delivery success and shortened vaginal delivery time, with no significant differences observed in cesarean rates across the groups.
